name: 探针1：沙箱边界
script: on('doubleTap', function (c) { var r = []; r.push('Packages=' + (typeof Packages)); r.push('java=' + (typeof java)); try { r.push('getClass=' + ('' + __bridge.getClass())); } catch (e) { r.push('getClass:blocked'); } try { r.push('getClassLoader=' + ('' + __bridge.getClass().getClassLoader())); } catch (e) { r.push('getClassLoader:blocked'); } var out = r.join(' | '); log('probe-sandbox 结果: ' + out); say('沙箱探针已执行，请看审计日志');});
